newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's JSE says electronic trading system down.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's JSE says electronic trading system down.

text.p: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange said on Monday it had shut down its electronic trading system due to a slow response-time mechanism.
The system had been operating with delayed response since start of trade and JSE president Roy Andersen said it had been shut down at 0830 GMT for repairs.
"We took it down. The JET (Johannesburg Equity Trading) system responses were not well. We will bring it up again," JSE president Roy Andersen told Reuters.
He said he did not know when JET would be back up but a statement would be issued once it was working normally again.
